Generates AI career recommendations from a student assessment.

Prerequisites (run in order):
1. Start Assessment
2. PATCH domain_category + domain (+ profile education/stream)
3. Save answers via POST /api/responses/ (repeat until dimensions complete)
4. Complete Assessment (recommended)

Requires GROQ_API_KEY and AI_RECOMMENDATIONS_ENABLED=true in server .env. Optional tracing uses AI_TRACING_ENABLED=true with LANGSMITH_API_KEY.

Response: { success, data: { ai_disclaimer, top_suggestions[{ id, recommendation, ... }], easy_decision_making[] } }

Asks the career-specific AI assistant about a saved recommendation suggestion.

Prerequisite: run AI Recommendations first and set {{career_suggestion_id_1}} from a returned top_suggestions/suggestions id. Use Chat Context (GET) to load chips and saved messages before the first message without calling AI.

Request body:
- suggestion_id: saved career suggestion id
- message: user's career-related question

Backend saves the chat and sends only a compact conversation summary to AI, not full history.

Response: { success, data: { career_name, suggestion_id, match_percentage, ai_insight, why_this_career, answer, chips, disclaimer, messages } }

item.name: Admin Users
item.description:
Super Admin / staff endpoints for creating and managing student users. Requires Bearer {{access_token}}. Base path: /admin-student-users/

Activate or deactivate students with PATCH {user_id}/update-status/ (status: active | inactive). Active students receive a password setup email when activated.

Soft-delete (archive): DELETE single student or PATCH bulk-archive. Students must be inactive before archiving. Restore archived students with PATCH bulk-restore. List archived students with GET archive-list.

request.description:
Admin-only: list student users (paginated).

GET /admin-student-users/

Requires Bearer {{access_token}} with admin permissions.

Optional query params: no_pagination, pagesize, search, ordering.

Admin-only: retrieve a single student profile by user id.

GET /admin-student-users/{user_id}/

Set {{user_id}} from create response or list students.

200 response: success, data (id, user, language, medium, education_level, stream, first_name, last_name, phone, email, country, country_name, state, state_name, city, city_name, referral_code)
404 if user is not a student or profile not found.

Admin-only: create a student from the dashboard.

POST /admin-student-users/

Multipart form-data: `data` (JSON string) + optional `profile_image`.

Required in `data`: email, first_name, country, state, city, terms_accepted
Optional: last_name, phone, address, referral_code, education_level, stream, medium, language (array of ids)

Do not send user_type — always creates a student.

No password in request. Password setup link is emailed immediately.
User stays pending until POST /auth/reset-password/.

201 response: success, message, user_id, user_type, must_change_password, created_by, created_at
400 response: success, errors

Admin-only: partially update an existing student.

PATCH /admin-student-users/{user_id}/

Set {{user_id}} from create response or list students.

Send only fields to change in `data` + optional `profile_image`.

Optional fields: email, first_name, last_name, phone, address, country, state, city, referral_code, education_level, stream, medium, language, terms_accepted

When email changes:
- Old email receives email-changed notification
- New email receives password setup link
- Account returns to pending until POST /auth/reset-password/

200 response: success, message, user_id, user_type
400 response: success, errors

Admin-only: activate or deactivate a student.

PATCH /admin-student-users/{user_id}/update-status/

Set {{user_id}} from create response or list students.

Body: status (required) — "active" or "inactive".

When status is set to active:
- is_active is set to true
- Password setup email is sent to the student

When status is set to inactive:
- is_active is set to false

Student must not be archived (deleted).
Already at the requested status returns 200 with success: false.

200 response: success, message
400 response: success, message (invalid status)
404 response: success, message (not found)

Admin-only: soft-delete (archive) a single student.

DELETE /admin-student-users/{user_id}/

Set {{user_id}} from create response or list students.

Student must be inactive before delete. Active students return 400.
Already-archived students return 200 with success: false.

200 response: success, message
400 response: success, message (active student)
404 response: success, message (not found)

Admin-only: list archived (soft-deleted) student users (paginated).

GET /admin-student-users/archive-list/

Requires Bearer {{access_token}} with admin permissions.

Ordered by deleted_at descending.

Optional query params: no_pagination, pagesize, search, ordering.

200 response: success, data (array of student users)

Admin-only: soft-delete (archive) multiple students.

PATCH /admin-student-users/bulk-archive/

Body: ids (non-empty array of user ids).

All students must be inactive. Active students in the set return 400.
Already-archived students in the set return 400.

200 response: success, message
400 response: success, message
404 response: success, message (none found)

Admin-only: restore archived students.

PATCH /admin-student-users/bulk-restore/

Body: ids (non-empty array of user ids).

All ids must refer to archived students. Already-active students in the set return 400.

200 response: success, message
400 response: success, message
